exposure: induction of labor with Prostaglandin E2
cohort: The study included 100 females undergoing induction of labor with Prostaglandin E2 at a tertiary care hospital in Lahore.
finding: The study found that 40% of women undergoing induction of labor had a cesarean section, with fetal distress being the most frequent indication (32.50%).
mod_finding: The frequency of cesarean section was higher in women undergoing induction of labour, and also higher in younger primiparous (55%) and obese women (42.5%).
